# opnsense_dyndns_account (Resource)

Dynamic DNS accounts (**Services ▸ Dynamic DNS**, plugin `os-ddclient`): the provider, credentials and host names updated with the firewall's address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_dyndns_account" "cloudflare" {
  service   = "cloudflare"
  username  = "token"
  password  = var.cloudflare_token
  zone      = "example.com"
  hostnames = ["fw.example.com"]
  checkip   = "if"
  interface = "wan"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `checkip` (String) How the firewall's current address is found: `if` / `if6` (address of `interface`), or a web service such as `cloudflare-ipv4` or `web_ipify-ipv4`. The values depend on the backend chosen in `opnsense_dyndns_settings`.
- `hostnames` (Set of String) Hostname to update.
- `service` (String) Select the service to use. One of `hosting1984`, `changeip`, `cloudflare`, `cloudns`, `digitalocean`, `dinahosting`, `dnsmadeeasy`, `dns-o-matic`, `dnsexit2`, `dyndns2`, `dnspark`, `dnspodcn`, `dslreports1`, `dondominio`, `duckdns`, `dynu`, `easydns`, `freedns`, `freemyip`, `gandi`, `godaddy`, `googledomains`, `he-net`, `he-net-tunnel`, `hetzner`, `inwx`, `keysystems`, `loopia`, `mythicdyn`, `namecheap`, `nfsn`, `njalla`, `noip`, `nsupdatev4`, `nsupdatev6`, `ovh`, `porkbun`, `regfishde`, `servercow`, `sitelutions`, `spdyn`, `strato`, `woima`, `yandex`, `zoneedit1`, `custom`.

### Optional

- `checkip_timeout` (Number) How long to wait before the checkip process times out. Defaults to `10`.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to ``.
- `dynipv6host` (String) Swap the interface identifier of the ipv6 address with the given partial ipv6 address (the least significant 64 bits of the address). Defaults to ``.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this virtual server. Defaults to `true`.
- `force_ssl` (Boolean) Force update using HTTPS, please note setting this option will enforce https updates on all accounts as ddclient only supports SSL=yes on a global level (the check ip service may still use HTTP on other services). Defaults to `true`.
- `interface` (String) Interface to monitor. Defaults to ``.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password associated with this account.
- `protocol` (String) Select the protocol to use. One of `dyndns1`, `dyndns2`, `get`, `post`, `put`. Defaults to ``.
- `resource_id` (String) resourceId. Defaults to ``.
- `server` (String) DynDNS Server hostname or uri to use (depending on the protocol). When a URI is provided, the tag __MYIP__ will be replaced with the current detected address for this service and __HOSTNAME__ will contain the (comma separated) list of hostnames provided. Defaults to ``.
- `ttl` (Number) Time to Live for the DNS entry. Defaults to `300`.
- `username` (String) Username or login to use. Defaults to ``.
- `wildcard` (Boolean) add a DNS wildcard CNAME record that points to the configured host. Defaults to `false`.
- `zone` (String) Zone containing the host entry. Defaults to ``.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the dynamic DNS account.
